The move he's building

The one-legged fade.

Dirk Nowitzki's one-legged fadeaway, the move he worked on all summer. Back to the basket on the block, he bumps his man for a sliver of space, turns on his right foot and fades off his left with the right knee up. Air Alamo: “there's no way anyone can reach the apex of his shot.” In games it's still a work in progress, the Express-News reported on Nov 16.

  1. The bump. Back to the rim on the block. Two bumps for a sliver of space.
  2. The pivot. He turns on his right foot to face up.
  3. The fade. Off the left foot, right knee up, falling away from the rim. The release is out of reach.
